NoirPanther server **0.1.7-r3** — built from Stump **0.1.7**, fork revision 3.

## New

- **Manga opens right-to-left by itself.** The `Manga` tag of `ComicInfo.xml`
  (`YesAndRightToLeft`) is now read and stored as the book's own reading direction; Stump only
  has a per-library default. The web reader (and the NoirPanther app) start such a book
  right-to-left; whatever the reader picks in the reader settings still wins.
  GraphQL: `Media.readingDirection` (resolved: file → library default) and
  `MediaMetadataModel.readingDirection` (what the file says, or null).

Contains one additive database migration (a nullable column). Books that were already scanned
pick the direction up after a library scan with _Force rebuild_.
